units.source_text: 一对年轻男女坐在架设在洼地里的秋千上。

en.t: A young man and woman were sitting on a swing set up in a hollow.

units.source_text: 我们从他们的旁边攀上小丘，在小丘顶端的一爿伞形顶的亭村歇息。

en.t: We climbed the small hill beside them and rested in a pavilion with an umbrella-shaped roof at the top.

units.source_text: 从这里向东眺望，可以饱览公园全貌；

en.t: Looking east from here, one could take in the whole park at a glance;

units.source_text: 向西眺望，则可以鸟瞰林木葱翠的保津川的流水。

en.t: looking west, one could look down over the flowing Hozu River, surrounded by lush green trees.

units.source_text: 荡秋千声像不断的咬牙声咯吱咯吱地传到了亭榭里来。

en.t: The creaking sound of the swing reached the pavilion like the ceaseless grinding of teeth.
